title: Sennacherib Invades Judah

questions.question: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, who came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:1 (ESV): "Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and took them."

questions.question: And the king of Assyria sent whom from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem, with a great army?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:2 (ESV): "And the king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh from Lachish"

questions.question: On what do you rest this trust of yours? Do you think that mere words are strategy and power for what?
Behold, you are trusting in Egypt, that broken reed of a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:6 (ESV): "that broken reed of a staff,"

questions.question: Is it not he whose high places and altars who has removed?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:7 (ESV): "whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed,"

questions.question: Come now, make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set what on them?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:8 (ESV): "if you are able on your part to set riders on them."

questions.question: How then can you repulse a single captain among the least of my master's servants, when you trust in Egypt for chariots and for what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:9 (ESV): "when you trust in Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?"

questions.question: The Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in the language of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:13 (ESV): "called out in a loud voice in the language of Judah:"

questions.question: Has any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:18 (ESV): "delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?"

questions.question: But they were silent and answered him not a word, for the king's command was, "Do not what him?"
Who went out to the Rabshakeh? Eliakim, Shebna, and whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:3 (ESV): "and Joah the son of Asaph, the recorder."

questions.question: Where did the Rabshakeh stand? By the conduit of the upper pool on the highway to the what field?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:2 (ESV): "on the highway to the Fuller's Field."

questions.question: Hezekiah's officials asked the Rabshakeh to speak in what language instead of the language of Judah?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:11 (ESV): "Pray, speak to your servants in Aramaic,"

questions.question: The Rabshakeh said that if they did not surrender, they would eat their own dung and drink their own what?
Make your peace with me and come out to me; then each one of you will eat of his own vine, and each one of his own what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 36:16 (ESV): "and each one of his own fig tree,"

key_verse_text: Beware lest Hezekiah mislead you by saying, "The LORD will deliver us." Has any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
